items.title: 阿曼Salalah Al Khadra Digital数据中心首期拟投资逾10亿英镑
items.title_en: Oman signs agreement for Salalah Al Khadra Digital data centre with over GBP1 billion first-phase investment
items.summary: 阿曼交通、通信与信息技术部与英国Yamna就萨拉拉Salalah Al Khadra Digital AI数据中心项目签署协议，首期拟投资超过10亿英镑。公告尚未披露具体装机规模或开工日期，属于拟开发基础设施。
items.summary_en: Oman's Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology and UK-based Yamna signed an agreement to advance the Salalah Al Khadra Digital AI data-centre project. First-phase investment is expected to exceed GBP1 billion. Capacity and construction start dates have not been disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 正式合作协议推进前期开发，但计划投资不等于已完成融资或投产。
items.why_it_matters_en: The agreement advances early development; proposed investment is not the same as financial close or operational capacity.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注后续融资、建设招标及电力和通信基础设施配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor financing, construction tenders and power and connectivity infrastructure requirements.
items.stage: 合作协议已签署／前期开发

items.title: 阿曼Al Bandar综合旅游开发项目签署约7亿里亚尔开发协议
items.title_en: Oman's Al Bandar integrated tourism development enters RO700 million development agreement
items.summary: 阿曼Urban October 2026活动期间公布Al Bandar综合旅游项目开发协议，披露投资额约7亿阿曼里亚尔。该消息于10月6日报道，为开发投资承诺，并非工程主合同授标。
items.summary_en: During Oman's Urban October 2026 programme, a development agreement was announced for the Al Bandar integrated tourism project with reported investment of approximately RO700 million. The announcement was reported on 6 October and does not constitute an EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 已公布大型旅游开发合作，但施工合同、分包和具体采购计划仍待披露。
items.why_it_matters_en: A major tourism-development commitment has been announced; construction awards and procurement remain to be disclosed.
items.gci_opportunity: 留意项目规划批准及正式施工采购节点。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Watch planning approvals and formal construction procurement notices.

items.title: 埃及与TMG签署四个综合地产项目开发协议，披露规模11万亿埃镑
items.title_en: Egypt and TMG announce four mixed-use development projects valued at EGP11 trillion
items.summary: 埃及政府与Talaat Moustafa Group于10月20日公布四个大型综合地产开发及运营项目协议，公布价值约11万亿埃镑。项目具体融资安排、建设标段和交付日程尚未完整披露。
items.summary_en: On 20 October, Egypt and Talaat Moustafa Group announced an agreement covering four major mixed-use development and operation projects, with a reported aggregate value of EGP11 trillion. Project-level financing, construction packages and schedules were not fully disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 为总体开发合作规模，不得将其解释为立即落实的施工合同金额。
items.why_it_matters_en: The figure relates to an overall development agreement, not immediately awarded construction contracts.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注项目立项、分期工程、建设合同和采购公告。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track phasing, construction contract awards and project procurement notices.

items.title: 里斯本市ITSM、ITAM及ITOM SaaS平台服务招标于10月26日截止
items.title_en: Lisbon's EUR1 million ITSM, ITAM and ITOM SaaS services tender closes 26 October
items.summary: 里斯本市政府采购IT服务管理、资产管理及IT运营管理SaaS平台及相关服务，预计金额100万欧元。原公告9月23日发布，提交截止2026年10月26日，采购编号59/CPI/DA/DCP/2026。
items.summary_en: The Municipality of Lisbon is procuring a SaaS platform and associated services for IT service management, IT asset management and IT operations management, estimated at EUR1 million. Published on 23 September, the tender closes on 26 October 2026 under reference 59/CPI/DA/DCP/2026.
items.why_it_matters: 截至当日仍有明确投标截止日期，金额为预算而非已签合同金额。
items.why_it_matters_en: The procurement has a forthcoming bid deadline; the amount is a tender estimate, not an awarded contract value.
items.gci_opportunity: 以正式电子采购平台要求核实供应商资格、语言及提交方式。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Review the official electronic tender platform for eligibility, language and submission requirements.

items.title: Eni推进委内瑞拉Junin 5重油项目，争取年底投资批准
items.title_en: Eni advances Venezuela's Junin 5 heavy-oil development toward year-end investment decision
items.summary: Eni于10月23日公布正推进委内瑞拉Junin 5重油项目，并争取于2026年底就首期作出最终投资决定。企业已向当地主管部门提交开发方案，首阶段计划将产量提高至约每日20万桶，仍取决于批准及投资决定。
items.summary_en: On 23 October, Eni said it is advancing Venezuela's Junin 5 heavy-oil development and targeting a final investment decision for phase one by the end of 2026. A development plan has been submitted, with an initial production objective of around 200,000 barrels a day, conditional on approvals and investment decision.
items.why_it_matters: 开发正在推进，但尚未完成最终投资批准，目标产量不是现有产能。
items.why_it_matters_en: Development is advancing but a final investment decision is pending; targeted output is not current production.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注最终投资决定、监管批准和后续工程采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor the final investment decision, regulatory approvals and later engineering procurement.
items.stage: 开发方案推进／待最终投资决定

items.title: SIFEM向非洲气候基础设施基金ATAF承诺投资1500万美元
items.title_en: SIFEM commits US$15 million to African Transition Acceleration Fund I
items.summary: 瑞士新兴市场投资基金SIFEM于10月22日公布，向African Transition Acceleration Fund I承诺投入1500万美元。基金由AIIM管理，目标规模2亿美元，计划支持非洲约10至15个可再生能源、储能、绿色燃料与可持续交通开发平台。
items.summary_en: On 22 October, the Swiss Investment Fund for Emerging Markets committed US$15 million to African Transition Acceleration Fund I, managed by AIIM. The fund targets US$200 million and aims to back roughly 10 to 15 early-stage renewable, storage, clean-fuel and sustainable-transport platforms in Africa.
items.why_it_matters: 1500万美元为SIFEM的出资承诺，2亿美元为基金募集目标，而非已全部募集。
items.why_it_matters_en: US$15 million is SIFEM's commitment, whereas US$200 million is the fund target, not confirmed fully raised capital.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注未来基金投资组合及其具体项目建设、供应和采购机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track future portfolio investments and their confirmed works, equipment and procurement opportunities.
